# Stetson University

> Stetson University is a nationally ranked private institution in Florida offering undergraduate and graduate programs across four colleges with a strong emphasis on experiential learning and research.

Founded in 1883, Stetson University serves students through its main DeLand campus in central Florida and additional locations including a Gulfport campus. The university is known for its Division-I athletics program, strong arts and culture offerings, and commitment to hands-on learning experiences.

## Academic Programs

- [Academics - Stetson University](https://www.stetson.edu/other/academics): Academic programs overview including undergraduate, graduate, and research options.
- [Undergraduate Programs - Stetson University](https://www.stetson.edu/other/academics/undergraduate): Explore undergraduate majors and minors available at Stetson University.
- [Graduate Programs - Stetson University](https://www.stetson.edu/other/academics/graduate): Graduate degree programs in business, counseling, education, and other fields.
- [Colleges and Schools - Stetson University](https://www.stetson.edu/other/academics/colleges-and-schools.php): Four colleges and schools: Arts & Sciences, Law, Business, and Music.
- [Academic Programs - Stetson University](https://www.stetson.edu/other/academics/programs.php): Directory of all academic programs including majors, minors, and degree options.

## Student Experience & Learning

- [Experiential Learning - Stetson University](https://www.stetson.edu/other/about/experiential-learning.php): Experiential learning through internships, research, study abroad, and capstone projects.
- [Research - Stetson University](https://www.stetson.edu/other/research): Undergraduate research, faculty research, and senior capstone project opportunities.
- [Libraries - Stetson University](https://www.stetson.edu/other/about/libraries.php): Three library resources including duPont-Ball Library and student success services.
- [Arts and Culture - Stetson University](https://www.stetson.edu/other/about/arts-and-culture.php): Arts and culture offerings including performances and community access programs.
